question.:question/problem:
Evaluate the integral. Give an exact answer.

$$
\int_{\frac{3 \pi}{10}}^{\frac{2 \pi}{5}} 6\sin\left(5 x\right)\,\mathrm{d}x
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Let $u=5 x.$ Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=5,\qquad \mathrm{d}x=\left(\frac{1}{5}\right)\mathrm{d}u.
$$

Transform both bounds using the same substitution:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\frac{3 \pi}{10}&\quad\Longrightarrow\quad u=5\left(\frac{3 \pi}{10}\right)+\left(0\right)=\frac{3 \pi}{2}\\ x=\frac{2 \pi}{5}&\quad\Longrightarrow\quad u=5\left(\frac{2 \pi}{5}\right)+\left(0\right)=2 \pi.\end{aligned}
$$

Substitute and integrate:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_{\frac{3 \pi}{10}}^{\frac{2 \pi}{5}} 6\sin\left(5 x\right)\,\mathrm{d}x&=6\left(\frac{1}{5}\right)\int_{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}^{2 \pi} \sin\left(u\right)\,\mathrm{d}u\\ &=\frac{6}{5}\int_{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}^{2 \pi} \sin\left(u\right)\,\mathrm{d}u\\ &=\frac{6}{5}\left[-\cos\left(u\right)\right]_{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}^{2 \pi}\\ &=- \frac{6}{5}\left(\cos\left(2 \pi\right)-\cos\left(\frac{3 \pi}{2}\right)\right)\\ &=- \frac{6}{5}\left(\left(1\right)-\left(0\right)\right)\\ &=- \frac{6}{5}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Evaluate the integral. Give an exact answer.

$$
\int 9\cos\left(2 - 6 x\right)\,\mathrm{d}x
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Let $u=2 - 6 x.$ Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=-6,\qquad \mathrm{d}x=\left(- \frac{1}{6}\right)\mathrm{d}u.
$$

Substitute and integrate:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int 9\cos\left(2 - 6 x\right)\,\mathrm{d}x&=9\left(- \frac{1}{6}\right)\int \cos\left(u\right)\,\mathrm{d}u\\ &=- \frac{3}{2}\int \cos\left(u\right)\,\mathrm{d}u\\ &=- \frac{3}{2}\left(\sin\left(u\right)\right)+C\\ &=- \frac{3}{2}\sin\left(2 - 6 x\right)+C.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/worked-solution:
Let $u=9 x.$ Then

$$

$$

Transform both bounds using the same substitution:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\frac{\pi}{9}&\quad\Longrightarrow\quad u=9\left(\frac{\pi}{9}\right)+\left(0\right)=\pi\\ x=\frac{\pi}{6}&\quad\Longrightarrow\quad u=9\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)+\left(0\right)=\frac{3 \pi}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Substitute and integrate:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_{\frac{\pi}{9}}^{\frac{\pi}{6}} 2\sin\left(9 x\right)\,\mathrm{d}x&=2\left(\frac{1}{9}\right)\int_{\pi}^{\frac{3 \pi}{2}} \sin\left(u\right)\,\mathrm{d}u\\ &=\frac{2}{9}\int_{\pi}^{\frac{3 \pi}{2}} \sin\left(u\right)\,\mathrm{d}u\\ &=\frac{2}{9}\left[-\cos\left(u\right)\right]_{\pi}^{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}\\ &=- \frac{2}{9}\left(\cos\left(\frac{3 \pi}{2}\right)-\cos\left(\pi\right)\right)\\ &=- \frac{2}{9}\left(\left(0\right)-\left(-1\right)\right)\\ &=- \frac{2}{9}.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Evaluate the integral. Give an exact answer.

$$
\int 2\sin\left(2 x + 6\right)\,\mathrm{d}x =
$$

{{answer}} $+C$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Let $u=2 x + 6.$ Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2,\qquad \mathrm{d}x=\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)\mathrm{d}u.
$$

Substitute and integrate:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int 2\sin\left(2 x + 6\right)\,\mathrm{d}x&=2\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)\int \sin\left(u\right)\,\mathrm{d}u\\ &=1\int \sin\left(u\right)\,\mathrm{d}u\\ &=1\left(-\cos\left(u\right)\right)+C\\ &=-\cos\left(2 x + 6\right)+C.\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:
Evaluate the integral. Give an exact answer.

$$
\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{7}} 3\cos\left(7 x\right)\,\mathrm{d}x
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Let $u=7 x.$ Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=7,\qquad \mathrm{d}x=\left(\frac{1}{7}\right)\mathrm{d}u.
$$

Transform both bounds using the same substitution:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=0&\quad\Longrightarrow\quad u=7\left(0\right)+\left(0\right)=0\\ x=\frac{\pi}{7}&\quad\Longrightarrow\quad u=7\left(\frac{\pi}{7}\right)+\left(0\right)=\pi.\end{aligned}
$$

Substitute and integrate:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{7}} 3\cos\left(7 x\right)\,\mathrm{d}x&=3\left(\frac{1}{7}\right)\int_{0}^{\pi} \cos\left(u\right)\,\mathrm{d}u\\ &=\frac{3}{7}\int_{0}^{\pi} \cos\left(u\right)\,\mathrm{d}u\\ &=\frac{3}{7}\left[\sin\left(u\right)\right]_{0}^{\pi}\\ &=\frac{3}{7}\left(\sin\left(\pi\right)-\sin\left(0\right)\right)\\ &=\frac{3}{7}\left(\left(0\right)-\left(0\right)\right)\\ &=0.\end{aligned}
$$
